title: get_changes_since vs get_changes_since_ordered: divergent sentinel logic for is_create
description: ContactStore::get_changes_since checks 'created_at > since_counter AND created_at > 0' for is_create. get_changes_since_ordered checks only 'created > since_counter' (no >0 guard). In the edge case of a row with created_at_counter=0 and since_counter=0, both methods agree (0>0=false). But if a corrupted row has created_at_counter=0 and since_counter<0 (malformed state token that somehow parses), get_changes_since says 'not created' (0>0 guard blocks), while get_changes_since_ordered says 'created' (0>-1=true). The two methods should apply identical sentinel logic to be interchangeable.
